## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Inline error line (old `.ops-error`, `.crm-error`, `#review-error`, `<p role="alert">`): danger text with an error icon, no box. End of a dialog body or form, or under the tabs it belongs to. Use `notice(text, 'danger')` only when the old web draws a boxed notice
